findings.summary: crates/setup/src/app.rs:159: /installed accepts any installation_id without checking it belongs to the new App, so a stray request could point match_repos at another App's installation. Fixed: match_repos checks GET /user/installations lists it with this App's app_id; test an_installation_of_another_app_is_left_alone.

crates/setup/src/app.rs:99-108: a failed repo match still exits 0 with 'Done'. Fixed: the cluster step still runs, then the run exits non-zero with 'not finished'; test without_a_gh_sign_in_it_says_which_repos_to_choose_and_exits_non_zero.

crates/setup/src/app.rs:216: repository_selection isn't read, so an install on all repositories isn't called out. Fixed: 'all' is refused with a message naming the repos to choose; test an_install_on_all_repositories_is_called_out.

crates/setup/src/app.rs:227: GitHub documents PUT/DELETE /user/installations/{id}/repositories/{repo_id} for classic PATs with repo scope; whether gh's OAuth token is accepted can't be shown with the stub. Left for Outcome; the fallback names the repos to choose. Noted in the PR as unverified.

crates/setup/src/app.rs:127-128,155: a run that stops after the conversion leaves an App on GitHub without saying so. Fixed: the timeout and the cluster-step errors name the App and where to delete it; a failed conversion answers the browser with a page.
crates/setup/src/app.rs:138-143: a 30s blocking read lets an idle preconnect socket hold up the real request. Fixed: a 2 second read timeout per connection.
